Really excellent
Nov 2025 • Couples
We went to this restaurant because we wanted to visit the monkey mountain... what a surprise! A very good welcome with lovely and caring waiters... the decoration is beautiful, the place bucolic and soothing and what about the dishes: EXCEPTIONAL

We shared a starter : beef meatballs and mozza asian style... AN EXPLOSION OF FLAVOURS

For my part, I opted for the duck fillet with honey and coffee sauce and its Mash potatoes and small vegetables: one of the BEST dishes I was given to taste.

Being myself a restaurateur in France I can only congratulate the chef for his know-how and these delicious flavours.

Just a small flat for the desserts that were sorely lacking in pep but it didn't take anything away from our pleasure

A big thank you to you for this delicious moment. I highly recommend this superb restaurant.
